scoring_notes: Scorer uses the byte gate compile path, with isolated scratch objects. An exact result additionally requires no unresolved relocations. No nonexact result was admitted.

Fitness and normalized diff counts are diagnostics, not byte coverage. Moved DIR32 operands can be patched from an inappropriate target offset in a nonexact candidate, so source literals and relocation identity still require the normal gates.
Early Action trial diagnostics decode the switch data as instructions; later trials exclude the known 188-byte table. Neither diagnostic is used as proof.
retained_source_policy: No unmatched reconstruction remains in Code/; partial sources stay in reverse/attempts.

remaining_wall.difference: Existing native instruction order, call/branch/table relationships and 20-state EH topology are retained; stack homes differ and a long healing-mask LEA adds three bytes. The previous E/J audits still apply.
remaining_wall.new_lever: Visible Coord3D::length reduces the frame to 0x2c0 but worsens other homes. It was not banked.
remaining_wall.not_progress: A plain inline chain helper obtains 3709 bytes by remaining out of line, replacing two native calls with an unowned helper; its superficially higher score is not a recovery.

new_hypotheses: Scoped/shared terrain bounds and center records; changed query initialization and healing iterator condition lifetime.
Visible range/closest wrappers, whole GeometryInfo constructor/destructor/collision body, Thing kind-mask worker and bit-test body; individually and in supported combinations.
Visible mask constructors/copy/filter-chain bodies with memcpy, field-copy and intrinsic combinations.
Third-switch source case order, shared-result exit forms and filter-chain/query wrappers with reference and pointer arguments.
Full geometry remains 0x5c: the Object next member at +0x104 and the existing allocation/size-check evidence rule out inventing extra geometry padding.
